field_map.form: only on recovered rows: EDGAR daily form index type, "4" or "4/A"
field_map.backfilledAt: only on recovered rows: ISO time the nightly completeness pass (server/edgarForm4Completeness.ts) fetched a filing the live poll had not archived; the row sits in the day file of that night (for an older day that can be months after filedAt), filedAt is the index's filing date; read by filed day with ?filed_from=&filed_to= on the history routes (server/filedDayHistory.ts)

confidence_model: as-filed regulatory records (high; filing errors possible, never corrected in-archive). Rows the live poll wrote from 2026-07-04 until the 2026-11-17 repair deployed include other form types (424B2, 424B3, 485BPOS, 497 and similar: EDGAR's type=4 listing is a prefix match) stored with issuerCik, issuerName and issuerTradingSymbol null and no owners or transactions: 189 of 600 rows filed 2026-11-13. They are not Form 4s; a reader counts a row only when issuerCik is set. From the repair on, the poll fetches only entries whose form type is exactly 4 or 4/A and never writes a row without an issuer
cadence: 15-min poll; day-file dedup by accession; nightly completeness pass against EDGAR's daily form index (02:00-06:00 ET, last 7 days), then the older weekdays back to 2026-07-04, newest first, up to 3,000 filings a night until every day is settled (a per-day ledger records index count vs held)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
